title: Trip Refund Evidence Duel
oneLiner: Travelers turn delay screenshots and policy snippets into a refund claim packet.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web prototype called Trip Refund Evidence Duel. It helps travelers convert delay receipts, hotel bills, chat screenshots, and staff promises into a reimbursement claim packet. Use community signals where travelers spent vacation time fighting airline/hotel refunds and where hotel reimbursement was verbally promised then denied. First screen promise: “Turn scattered proof into one claim they can answer.” Core workflow: build trip timeline, upload or paste proof cards, tag verbal promises, compare carrier reason codes, generate claim strength meter, and preview a polite reimbursement email. Emotional pressure: anger at losing vacation time and money while being bounced between support teams. Trigger moment: within 48 hours after denial. Output artifact: a downloadable claim packet and email draft. Use the operator-dense profile: crisp compact rows, slate/charcoal surfaces, one urgent accent, tabular numbers, no decorative hero.
